I've been playing Hunt: Showdown for over 4 years and have accumulated more than 2,000 hours. It's a game I always find myself coming back to, especially when playing with friends. I don't play much solo, as I find the experience much more enjoyable with a group.
If you're new, I'd recommend starting with Soul Survivor to learn the maps, get comfortable with the mechanics, and pick up some of the basics before jumping into Bounty Hunt trios. It's also a great way to get started if you don't have teammates lined up for duos or trios.
Like any game, Hunt has its pros and cons, and it definitely has a learning curve. But if you're willing to put in the time, it's a rewarding experience with plenty of memorable moments. It's a game I'll always come back to for more bayou chaos with friends!
